FOR THOSE EXPERIENCING FUR ISSUES

If your fur looks thick and stiff, try this solution:

To fix the fur issue in Unreal Engine, go to WolfFurMaterial and then

Blending Mode: Masked

Shading Model: Hair

Two-Sided

Create Ray-Traced Shadows

and set the Roughness Value to 5.0

Set the Specular Value to 0.2

Set the Diffusion Value to 0.8

Add the DitherTemporalAA node from the Texture Sample’s RGB section and connect it to the Opacity Mask

@boxy_the_gamer_01 I've been feeling incredibly overwhelmed lately. My schedule has become so packed that I can barely keep up with everything going on in my life. On top of that, with Christmas just a week away, I need to focus on decorating the pizzaplex, which is a huge task in itself. It feels like I'm juggling too many things at once, and I’m starting to lose track of my social media profiles—I have so many that it's impossible to stay on top of them all.

The stress is really taking a toll on me; I've reached a point where I'm feeling downright depressed. I've found myself crying more often, and it’s worrying my friends who have been reaching out to check on me. Not only do I have a mountain of requests piling up on my DeviantArt profile, but my YouTube channel has also been neglected for way too long. I simply don’t have the energy to create content or engage with my audience the way I’d like to.

Because of all of this, I've made the difficult decision to retire from Sketchfab. It feels like the right choice for my mental health, and I need to take a step back to regain some balance in my life.
